title: core: Python analyzer (variables, CFG, types, use-sites)
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W1]
Seats: INTEL-04
Add crates/core/src/analyze/python.rs implementing the same output shape as INTEL-2's rust.rs using tree-sitter-python: variables (assignment targets, params, class attributes/globals) with read/write counts and scope; FunctionCfg (if/elif/else, for/while, try/except, with, return) with cyclomatic + nesting; TypeNode for classes (fields from self.x assignments, methods, docstring); UseSites for calls/field access/var reads+writes. Reuse analyze/mod.rs shared helpers from INTEL-2 (import them; do not duplicate). Owner: crates/core/src/analyze/python.rs only. Depends: INTEL-2 (analyze/mod.rs helpers) — if INTEL-2 has not landed yet, coordinate through the card. Verify: cargo test -p repowalk-core (inline test on a small python snippet: for+if -> cyclomatic, unused variable, class with method).

EVIDENCE (2026-10-15, TL-INTEL):
FILE: crates/core/src/analyze/python.rs (only file changed; analysis.rs/rust.rs/ts.rs/mod.rs untouched).
ALL FOUR PARTS DONE:
  1. Variables — assignment/aug/annotated/tuple targets, params (typed/default/splat), class-body attrs, `self.x` fields (VarKind::Field), module-level globals; id `file:decl_line:name`; type_name ONLY from explicit annotation; reads/writes + first/last use counted from name events in the declared scope; `enclosing` via shared enclosing_symbol.
  2. CFG — one FunctionCfg per function_definition (incl. async); Entry/Block/Branch/Loop/Match/Call/Return/Exit; edges Normal/True/False/Back (loop body -> Loop Back edge); cyclomatic = if+elif+for+while+except+case+bool-op + 1; max_nesting counted. Labels carry real source (condition/iter/call name).
  3. Types — TypeKind::Class per class; fields from self.x (and class-body) assignments; methods from symbols by container match (fallback: class-body defs); doc from symbol/docstring; TypeEdge Inherit for bases, Field for annotated fields whose base name matches a declared class; module_path best-effort. CHOICE: Impl edges intentionally skipped for Python (method ownership is implicit in the class body).
  4. Use sites — Call, TypeRef, FieldAccess, VarRead/VarWrite; target = symbol id / variable id / attribute name; line+col 1-based; snippet via shared helper. Deterministic sort by (file,line,col,target).
